about: Real-life questions (made by make.py and make-media.ps1 from their own data): one person's messy folder, asked as people ask. For measuring only, never for tuning.

questions.question: I missed the team call on 3 March (it's in Recordings). What's the new launch date, and what was I asked to do?
In the recording of the 3 March team call, what budget cap did finance approve?
My landlord left me a voicemail. When is the plumber coming, and where should I leave the key?
What was the gate code for the storage unit? I recorded a voice memo about it.
Which e-mails in my Inbox still need a reply from me? Just the ones where someone is waiting on me.
When does Priya need the Q1 report?
Can I claim the whole dinner on the receipt photo in Downloads (IMG_2041.png)? I ate alone. Check our expense policy.
There's a photo of a parking fine in my Downloads. How much is it, and by when do I have to pay?
Are there any duplicate files in my Downloads folder (the same file saved twice)?
How much did I spend on taxis in March? It's in my expenses workbook in Finance.
What did I spend on groceries in March, going by my bank export? FreshMart and Corner Grocer are my grocery shops.
Has Brightwater paid invoice INV-2291 yet? If not, how much do they still owe me?
What changed between price list v1 and v2 in Work?
What price did we quote Lumen in the latest proposal, and when do we deliver?
How much does Lumen pay at kick-off, according to the proposal?
Going by this week's standup notes, what is the release waiting on?
How do I cancel my gym membership, and how much notice do I have to give?
How much flour do I need for the pancakes if we're 6 people?
What's our wifi password at home? I wrote it down somewhere.
Am I free on Thursday 12 March in the afternoon? Check my calendar in Home.
What's the latest I can get to the airport for my Lisbon flight and still check in my bag?
This month I have to pay the parking fine and my gym fee. How much is that together?
Is the launch date from the 3 March team call before or after the Lumen kick-off date in the proposal, and by how many days?
